claim: Demo — sample data, nothing is saved
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; mutate/reset sample data; assert the real database is unchanged and demo records are cleared on exit

claim: Works offline after the first visit
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; wait for the service worker; visit Privacy and Terms; set context offline; navigate back to /demo and perform recall

claim: Your phrases and recordings stay on this device
where: landing facts, settings, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh /demo flow; capture a unique phrase while recording all requests; assert no request leaves the product origin or contains phrase data

claim: The core capture, recall, and export loop works without an account
sandbox: fresh /demo flow; assert there is no account action, then capture and recall a phrase without authentication

claim: No analytics, advertising, trackers, remote fonts, or third-party runtime scripts
sandbox: fresh /demo flow while recording every request; assert only the product origin is contacted and no analytics or remote script is present

claim: Microphone access is requested only after pressing Record voice
sandbox: fresh /demo capture view with an instrumented mediaDevices API; assert zero calls on load and one call after Record voice

claim: Existing Plus license holders can restore private shuffle
where: Settings, privacy page, terms page, README
sandbox: fresh real-data entry with the Sociobot verification response mocked valid; restore a token and assert shuffle appears in recall
fresh /demo sample data; download CSV; assert its header and exactly one row per sample phrase

claim: Exports a passphrase-encrypted backup that the same passphrase can restore
sandbox: fresh /demo sample data; export with a passphrase; assert no plaintext; clear the library; decrypt and restore all samples with that passphrase

claim: JSON backups can restore a phrase library
sandbox: fresh /demo sample data; export JSON, delete every phrase, import that file, and assert all sample rows return

claim: Imported phrases merge by ID, keeping the newest version
sandbox: fresh /demo sample data; import older and newer versions of one existing ID; assert the older loses, the newer wins, and no duplicate is created
fresh /demo capture view with fake media stream and controlled browser clock; assert recording at 9.999 seconds and stopped at 10 seconds

claim: Phrases return on a 1, 3, 7, 14 and 30-day schedule
sandbox: fresh /demo data; assert failed recall stores 1 day, then assert visible controls and stored dates for successful 3, 7, 14 and 30-day stages

claim: An installed copy discovers and activates a new offline shell
sandbox: local server first serves the previous release worker and shell, switches to dist, then asserts the new worker activates and the repaired shell loads
